• Just now
Seen • Just now
For store purchases, you can cancel for a full refund within 3 days of purchase if the order has not shipped. Once shipped, cancellation is no longer possible, and delivered bottles generally can’t be returned for a change of mind or taste. Personalized/engraved items, presales, special releases, and seasonal items are non-returnable and non-refundable unless stated otherwise. 
If there’s an issue with a delivered order, report it within 7 days of delivery and include your order number, a description, and clear photos of the package and contents. EU-site orders may be returned within 14 days of delivery under EU rules, with return postage and packaging paid by the customer.
